
## What?

What is the bug? What areas does it affect?

## Where?

Have you traced the bug down to a smaller area? A library, file, function, line of code, word?

## Why?

Why does it occur? What steps can we take to replicate it? Please provide as much context as possible.

## Your environment

Tell us about your Golang version, operating system (and distribution if running GNU/Linux), and anything else.

## Comments

Provide anything else you might deem relevant, and maybe even add some screenshots.
